sections.heading: Equipping an Essence
sections.body: Absorbing an Essence unlocks it, but it does not help in combat until it is placed in a loadout.

sections.heading: What to do
sections.body: Open the Archive tab, select Equip Essence to add your First Hunt Essence to your draft, then save the loadout to apply your changes. Unsaved loadout changes are highlighted on the Save button.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: After this step, you will craft and equip your first weapon. Your Essence and weapon together prepare you for your first Lumo Ruins expedition.
